Job Description
What we're doing at Uscreen
Uscreen is the video monetization platform for businesses building recurring revenue from video content. Our customers replace a patchwork stack of separate hosting, community, courses, email, and app vendors with one branded experience across web, mobile, and TV.
The platform is only half of it. We believe growth requires behavior, not just software. Customers don't stall because a feature is missing. They stall because they priced wrong, never built an email list, or launched an offer nobody wanted. Coaching is how we fix that, and it's part of the product rather than an add-on.
The job
You own a segment, and you run it like a growth marketer.
We have a cohort of smaller video businesses where retention is not where it should be. Nobody owns it today. You will. The revenue that stays in that segment, and the revenue that grows inside it, is yours.
This is a coaching role for someone with a growth marketer's mindset. We wouldn't hire a demand gen marketer who couldn't analyze the state of the business and figure out what's needed, and we won't hire a coach who can't either. You'll look at a customer's business the way an owner would: where the revenue comes from, where it leaks, and what to do next. You pull your own numbers to get there. When a customer needs a custom report to answer a growth question, you build it yourself.
It's a one-to-many job. Your cohort is larger than a 1:1 book, so the work is designing coaching that scales: cohort programs, group sessions, office hours, and triggered outreach when the data says a business is drifting. You'll build that motion rather than inherit it.
Success is measured in dollars: gross revenue retention in your cohort first, expansion second. Not tickets closed, not calls booked.
What you'll do
Own gross revenue retention and expansion for an assigned segment of customers
Diagnose each business the way an operator would: read their numbers, find the real constraint, and turn it into a plan they can act on
Coach customers through the decisions that move revenue: pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, retention mechanics
Run group coaching sessions, cohort programs, office hours, and async coaching inside Membership+
Answer customers' growth questions with their own data, including our largest accounts, and build a custom report when they need one, like how their paid search campaigns are performing
Spot which accounts in your segment are drifting, and work with the team lead to measure which coaching plays actually move retention
Build the playbooks and session formats that make this repeatable. You're the first person in this seat, and what you build becomes how we scale it
Bring what you learn back to Product and Success. You'll be closer to this segment than anyone at the company
Who we're looking for
A coach with a growth marketer's mindset. Maybe you've run growth or demand gen for a small business, built your own audience, or coached founders through their numbers. You understand how a membership business makes money, you pull your own analytics to see what's working, and you're comfortable doing it in front of a client. What matters is that you can find the real constraint in a business, then sit with the operator and say the honest thing.
3 to 5 years in growth marketing, demand gen, coaching, consulting, or running your own online business, with real ownership of an outcome
Business acumen. You understand pricing, funnels, retention, and unit economics, and can explain how a business makes money
You self-serve your own analytics. You get answers from dashboards, BI tools, and AI without waiting on a data team
Can read retention curves, cohort behavior, and funnel conversion and form a point of view
Comfortable walking a non-technical business owner through their numbers live and answering their questions on the spot
Strong live facilitation: group sessions, workshops, webinars, 1:1 calls
Working fluency with AI tools for research, prep, analysis, and synthesis. Our team uses Claude daily to prep sessions, analyze customer data, and build coaching assets. You should reach for these tools rather than around them
Clear, simple communication. Complex idea in, plain sentence out
Bonus points if you:
Have worked as a marketing or growth analyst
Have built reports in a BI tool like Lightdash, Looker, Tableau, or Metabase
Write SQL, especially in BigQuery
Have been a creator, coach, or small business owner yourself
Have worked with video businesses, online educators, or subscription and membership businesses
Know the surrounding stack: Kit/ConvertKit, YouTube, Kajabi, Circle, Squarespace, Meta and IG, and the ad platforms' reporting
Have built a scaled or one-to-many customer program before
What's hard about this job
We'd rather you know now.
You'll own a number you can't fully control.
Some customers won't take the advice and will churn anyway. You have to own your influence over an outcome rather than the outcome itself.
It's a lagging metric.
Retention moves slowly. Your variable is protected for your first two quarters because of this. You'll be doing the work for months before the number reflects it.
The motion doesn't exist yet.
Playbooks exist for our 1:1 coaching. The scaled version for this segment is an open question you'll help answer. If you need a finished playbook on day one, this will frustrate you.
You'll switch modes all day.
A customer's numbers in the morning, a group session after lunch, an honest conversation with a founder before end of day. If you want to go deep on one kind of work all week, this isn't it.
You'll deliver honest assessments to people emotionally invested in what they've built.
That takes a specific kind of nerve, especially when the data is what's delivering the bad news.
What we offer
Flexible PTO + 8 company holidays
Remote, global team
Paid parental leave
Medical, dental, and vision (US based)
Technology and home office stipend
Coworking space stipend
Annual learning stipend
Benefits may vary depending on location and local regulations. Final eligibility and coverage details will be shared during the hiring process.

Job Description
About LiveKit
LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.
About This Role
We're hiring a Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) to be the technical partner to the engineers and enterprises building on LiveKit.
You'll work alongside an account executive to understand what a customer is trying to build, design the right architecture, and bring it to life with live demos and proofs-of-concept — guiding teams from first conversation to production.
This role is ideal for someone who loves to build, is energized by talking with other engineers, and takes pride in turning a hard technical problem into something that just works. Real-time voice and video is visceral — latency, quality, and reliability are felt, not read about — so the best conversations include something live. You'll collaborate closely with our Sales, Engineering, Product teams to win technical decisions and to make sure what you hear in the field informs how we build.
You'll thrive here if you:
love to build and solve the most challenging customer problems with LiveKit
have a curious mind with a continuous desire to learn and improve
enjoy demoing and presenting, whether to a room or engineer, to a CTO or at a conference
have a team first mentality, seeking to lift others around you as you progress in your career
What You'll Do
Partner with an account executive as the technical lead on strategic deals — from discovery and architecture design through demos, POCs, and technical decisions
Advise customers on cloud architecture and deployment across self-hosted and LiveKit Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Build live demos and reference applications — voice agents, video pipelines, telephony integrations — tailored to each customer's use case, and reusable by the wider team
Scope and run proofs-of-concept against clear, shared success criteria, guiding customers all the way to production
Reason with customers about connectivity, infrastructure, and end-to-end latency to design for scale and reliability
Create technical content — blog posts, guides, webinars, and conference talks — that helps developers and enterprises build with LiveKit
Act as the technical enabler for your region's pod, and share field insight with Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap
Who You Are
4+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role (or equivalent hands-on engineering experience with strong customer instincts)
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — you can architect, deploy, and debug real applications
Comfortable with the modern deployment toolchain: containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and networking fundamentals (load balancing, DNS, firewalls/NAT)
Able to reason about connectivity, infrastructure, and latency end to end — how architecture, network path, compute, co-location, and model choice shape the AI agentic experiences of today
Strong programming ability in at least one of our core SDK languages — Python, TypeScript/Node, or Go
A clear communicator who can demo, present, and write for technical audiences
Nice to Have
Working knowledge of real-time media protocols and their latency/quality trade-offs (WebRTC, RTP/SRTP, WebSockets)
Familiarity with the AI voice stack: STT/TTS providers, LLM integration, speech-to-speech models, turn detection, and telephony/SIP
Experience speaking at meetups or conferences, or a track record of technical writing or open-source contributions
Our Commitment to You
An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world
Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers
Competitive salary and equity package
Health, dental, and vision benefits
Flexible vacation policy

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
About the Role
As a Sales Engineer it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.
You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.
In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.
The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.
This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.
What you'll be doing:
Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio
Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda
Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects
Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions
Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents
Team with Account Executives to develop accounts
Organize and execute pre-sales engagements
Implement code snippets
Create and maintain pre-sales content and technical artifacts

Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
Strong Technical Foundation:
A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of programming fundamentals, modern software engineering practices, and common IT/system architectures.
Proven Sales Engineering Experience:
Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.
Communication Excellence:
Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Language Proficiency:
Fluent in English (C1/C2 level or native proficiency)
Travel Flexibility:
Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration..

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
About the role
We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Repository Services team in GitLab's Create stage. The team owns the repository side of Source Code: how code gets into a repository, who may change it, and how those changes are verified. We build this as an access layer on the primitives the Gitaly team provides, for GitLab's own features and for the artificial intelligence agents now writing and pushing code alongside people.
You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL across GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Repository Services is a new team, and its first months are about reliability and support, so you'll spend real time on performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency, with experienced team members to lean on. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and the other Source Code teams.
What you'll do
Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.
Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.
Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified.
Build on the primitives Gitaly provides and work closely with the Gitaly team.
Triage and fix bugs and support requests for the features the team owns.
Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.
Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.
Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.
Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.
What you'll bring
Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.
An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.
Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.
Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.
Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.
Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.
The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.
About the team
Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, formed in September 2026 when Source Code split into focused teams. As the split is finalized we expect to own repository mirroring, Git Large File Storage (LFS), protected branches and Branch Rules, push rules, Code Owners (shared with Code Review), and commit and tag signing. We build on Gitaly's primitives and meet regularly with the Gitaly team, and our work serves GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated.

description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
About the role:
As a Technical Writer at Camunda, you'll be embedded within product teams, taking full ownership of documentation for key areas of our platform. You'll work side-by-side with engineers, product managers, and designers to ensure our documentation is clear, accurate, and closely aligned with the product experience. This is a hands-on role where you'll become a subject matter expert, directly shaping the developer journey through high-impact content across the Camunda platform.
Beyond content, you'll help maintain and configure the infrastructure that keeps our documentation running smoothly. We're looking for someone who can unblock themselves and the team when something breaks. Day to day, this can mean:
Troubleshooting and fixing failing GitHub Actions workflows, including reading CI logs, isolating the breaking change, and getting the build green again.
Reviewing and merging contributions from engineers and the wider community, and keeping branches and versioned docs releases in good shape.
Diagnosing broken links, redirects, MDX and rendering errors, and search indexing issues across current and versioned content.
Handling Docusaurus, Node, and dependency upgrades, and resolving the breakages that come with them.
Improving the tooling, automation, and linting that writers and contributors rely on, so our publishing process stays fast and predictable
You don't need to be a full-time developer, but you should be confident with Git and GitHub workflows, the command line, YAML and JavaScript-based config, Markdown/MDX, and reading an error trace far enough to know whether you can fix it or need to pull in an engineer.
You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team focused on helping developers become productive with Camunda technologies quickly and joyfully. Developers with technical writing experience are encouraged to apply.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Own and drive the documentation for one or more product areas, acting as the embedded technical writer within the corresponding product teams.
Maintain and improve our documentation site's technical infrastructure, including build tooling, deployment pipelines, and Docusaurus platform configuration, to keep publishing fast, reliable, and scalable.
Work closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to stay deeply informed about the product roadmap and ensure documentation is accurate, timely, and aligned with feature development.
Become a subject matter expert in your assigned product areas, developing hands-on experience with Camunda products to create documentation that reflects real-world usage and developer needs.
Lead documentation efforts from concept through to release, including planning, writing, reviewing, and maintaining content that empowers developers to succeed with Camunda technologies.
Advocate for documentation as a critical part of the user experience, bringing the user’s perspective into product discussions and influencing design and implementation where appropriate.
Continuously improve the structure, clarity, and completeness of the documentation based on analytics, user feedback, and your own insights.
Collaborate with other writers and the broader Documentation team to share best practices, contribute to team goals, and evolve our documentation tooling and standards.
What You Bring:
3+ years of technical writing experience and a strong portfolio of developer-focused content such as user guides, installation guides, API references, tutorials, and technical blog posts.
Proven experience of maintaining, troubleshooting, configuring, and extending documentation site infrastructure and deployment pipelines, preferably using Docusaurus.
Hands-on experience with Java, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and related technologies, and a proven ability to deeply understand, use, and test complex technical products (ideally with Camunda 8 or similar products).
Experience with writing about on-premise software installation or other technical environments, as well as SaaS and software documentation.
Proven ability to tailor content for diverse audiences and technical backgrounds, including software engineers, application developers, business analysts, and process owners.
Experience with docs-as-code workflows and documentation frameworks such as Docusaurus, and using AI, Git, and Markdown in a developer-centric environment.
Ability and/or willingness to use our product.
Nice-to-haves:
Software engineering experience, or proficiency with one or more programming languages.
Comfortable iterating on an existing technical writing style guide and advocating for its cross-functional use.

Compensation
We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.
The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. United States: $102,300.00 to $164,900.00
United Kingdom: £64,200.00 to £105,600.00
Singapore: S$127,000.00 to S$190,500.00
Canada: C$108,600.00 to C$178,600.00
If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.
Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).
Benefits & Perks
We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.
Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.
In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.
Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.
Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.
Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!
AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here
”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!
Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!
Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.
Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
About the role
As an Intermediate Backend Engineer, you will take backend features and improvements from clarifying the problem through shipping them and following up in production. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.
Why you’ll love this role
Ownership: You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.
Learning and Growth : You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.
Innovative Culture: You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.
Autonomy: You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.
User-Centric Collaboration: You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.
What you’ll do
Own and Ship Features: Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.
Build for Production: Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.
Test and Review: Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.
Operate What You Build: Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
Leverage AI: Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.
What you’ll bring
Backend Fundamentals: Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.
Adaptability: Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.
Feature Ownership: The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, working independently while seeking input at the right time.
Practical Judgment: Sound instincts about security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational risk, plus an understanding of modular backend boundaries and the consequences of coupling.
Clear Communication: Strong written communication and effective collaboration in a remote, asynchronous environment.
AI Fluency: Practical experience with AI coding tools, including the ability to review and correct what they generate.
Helpful experience
Production Go services, APIs, concurrency, profiling, or gRPC.
Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, or cloud deployment.
Rust, particularly for systems, security, performance, or platform work.
PostgreSQL, schema evolution, caching, queues, messaging, or event-driven workflows.
Observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
Contributing to a modular monolith, bounded context, shared component, or independently operated service.

Flexible Paid Time Off

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. Job Description
In a world where many social apps measure their success by time spent online, Places offers a different kind of product built by Raya, a technology company focused on providing utility. Our apps, Raya and Places, are tools for discovery of and access to exciting people and places globally. We believe that by marrying great software with a membership-based community built around core values of trust, curation, and authenticity, we can provide solutions that offer something different to infinite content and AI-slop. Places’ mission is to help discerning global travelers find their favorite places wherever they go through expert curation and community trust.
As a Data Scientist on the Places by Raya team you will play a key role that will shape how the Places app uses data to drive business decisions. This hands-on role combines data modeling and reporting with product analysis and experimentation. While the product itself has existed since 2023 the culture is very much like a new start-up with leadership being heavily invested in this product space and this role being the first dedicated Data Scientist to this space and supported by a dedicated Data Engineer.

Successful candidates will demonstrate technical skills, product expertise, and business acumen, and be enthusiastic about making a positive impact through timely execution. An overview of this role
As a Benefits Analyst on GitLab's Total Rewards team, you'll support global benefits administration and take ownership of day-to-day benefits operations in India, partnering closely with a Senior Benefits Analyst. Your initial priorities will include planning benefits events at the Bangalore hub, streamlining enrollment and benefits onboarding , handling tier 1 benefit questions and escalations, taking over and improving administrative and audit processes, along with routine benefits tasks.You'll build depth in global benefits and manage assigned work with increasing independence, seeking guidance on prioritization, new assignments, and higher-risk issues. What You’ll Do
Support day-to-day administration for assigned benefits programs, including eligibility, enrollment, benefits onboarding, billing, reporting, audits, quality assurance, documentation, and issue resolution, with a particular focus on India.
Review benefits and team-member data from multiple sources, research discrepancies and root causes, and recommend next steps for manager or senior team-member review.

Plan, host, and manage benefits events at the Bangalore hub, and coordinate assigned benefits activities across selected countries and employment arrangements. Apply documented processes and escalate questions that require deeper local or technical expertise.
Partner with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, and People Technology on accurate reporting, billing reconciliation, eligibility data, and compliance-related processes.
Support People Operations in resolving team-member benefits inquiries, explain moderately complex benefits topics in accessible language, and escalate cases appropriately.
Analyze benefits utilization, cost, survey, and qualitative data to identify trends and prepare summaries, insights, and recommendations that support team priorities.
Maintain accurate documentation, process guides, trackers, and communications; support the transition of administrative processes and recommend ways to simplify, standardize, or automate them, including responsible use of artificial intelligence tools. Protect accuracy and team-member experience, communicate progress and risks, and seek guidance on prioritizing improvements.
What You’ll Bring
Experience supporting benefits administration, including enrollment, reporting, and audits, and working with benefits brokers or vendors. Experience supporting benefits in more than one country is required; global technology company experience is preferred. Strategic benefits plan design experience isn't required.
Working knowledge of core benefits concepts, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental benefits.
Experience using a human resources information system (HRIS), benefits administration platform, or similar operational tools, with attention to detail in data entry, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance. Workday experience is preferred.
Intermediate or stronger Excel or Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUPs, filters, pivot tables, and data analysis; macros aren't required. Ability to evaluate multiple sources, identify patterns or discrepancies, and develop evidence-based recommendations with appropriate guidance.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits topics in accessible language and collaborate across functions.
Ability to manage assigned work, meet deadlines, communicate when blocked, and distinguish urgent work from work that can be sequenced.
A collaborative, learning-oriented approach, willingness to apply feedback, and curiosity about using artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve benefits work and team processes.
Ability to be based in Bangalore and go to our Bangalore hub to host and manage benefits events, with flexibility for collaboration across time zones, including Pacific time.

The Benefits team within Total Rewards supports global benefits programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. You'll work closely with the Senior Benefits Analyst and colleagues in India, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Pacific time zones to support India's growing benefits needs. description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
This is a future opportunity that may not be immediately available, but we're proactively building our pipeline of exceptional talent. At GitLab, we believe in connecting with outstanding professionals before we have an urgent need, allowing us to move quickly when the right moment arises. If you are excited about co-creating the future as we're building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, we want to hear from you. We'll keep your information on file and reach out when a position becomes available that matches your skills and interests.
An overview of this role
This position is 100% remote and will be based in the United States and/ or Canada.
GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.
Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.
We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.
What you’ll do
Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.
Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.
Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.
Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.
Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.
Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.
Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.
What you’ll bring
Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.
Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.
Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.
Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.
Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.
Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.
Previous tech industry experience or experience in sales development, marketing, or sales is a plus.
About the team
As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.
Remote-Global
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
United States Salary Range
$59,000—$84,000 USD
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

description:
Nova is looking for a hands-on Software Team Lead to shape a new technology product that will form Nova's next-generation platform for the semiconductor industry. This is an opportunity to define the architecture, stay close to the code and lead a motivated team of three developers and one quality assurance (QA) engineer. Combining advanced software, hardware integration and creative problem-solving, you will turn complex challenges into reliable C#/.NET solutions, drive rapid delivery and champion GitHub Copilot, reusable skills and dedicated agents.
Role Responsibilities:
What will you be doing:
- Lead architecture, planning and delivery of a new technology product and Nova's next-generation platform.
- Develop core C#/.NET components and guide integration with hardware interfaces and data-processing services.
- Mentor three developers and a QA engineer; lead design reviews, code reviews and practical GitHub Copilot adoption.
- Build a positive, supportive team culture; lead with empathy and enthusiasm, motivate people, remove blockers and help the team deliver on commitments.
- Work with product, algorithm, hardware and QA teams to turn requirements into working software.
- Own software quality, automated testing, performance and reliable software deployments.
Pool Position Flag:
No
REQUIREMENTS
- Bsc.in computer science or equivalent
- 4+ years of hands-on software design and development experience.
- 3 years of proven managerial experience
- Expert-level C#/.NET, with strong software architecture, concurrency and debugging skills.
- Proven hands-on technical leadership, mentoring and end-to-end project delivery.
- Strong practical GitHub Copilot skills for implementation, refactoring, testing and debugging, including creating reusable skills (SKILL.md), context engineering and dedicated agents; independently review and validate generated code.
- Hands-on Docker experience, including deployment and troubleshooting.
- Working knowledge of Python for automation, tooling and integration.
- Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated tests and service/API integration.
- Strong knowledge of hardware interfaces and hands-on experience integrating software with hardware, including device communication and troubleshooting hardware-software interactions.
Advantages:
- Semiconductor or other multidisciplinary systems; image-processing integration; gRPC and SQL databases. Experience building in-house AI/LLM infrastructure, including model hosting, integration and evaluation.
That special something you bring in:
- Empathetic, enthusiastic and supportive leadership that motivates people and helps the team deliver.
- Clear communication, strong ownership and collaboration across disciplines.
﻿Get to know us better
Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a global company and a leading provider of innovative metrology solutions for process control in semiconductor manufacturing.
With a team of ~1200 people in three R&D centers and 27 field offices, we bring insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage multiple technology fields such as physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms to develop hardware and software solutions that measure almost every advanced computer chip built in the world.
Nova dives deep into dimensions and layers at the atomic level to extract unique insights and provide our customers with crucial decision-making data, handling critical challenges by providing unique, differentiated solutions.
Our outstanding people-focused and innovative culture means every person at Nova has the power to make an impact and significantly redefine what people can achieve through technology.
Join us if you are A dreamer and brilliant high aimer who sees the impossible as the starting point and loves working in a multidisciplinary global team to create innovative breakthroughs.

description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana Labs is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition based in Spain who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across Iberia . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We’re strong proponents of a consultative sales approach – learn about the customer’s needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Outbound prospecting into net-new customers Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & Spanish. Bonus Points For: Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Rewards In Spain, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 170,000 – EUR 220,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs’ success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture – As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding – We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key – We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. 🇫🇷 Head of Product - AI x EdTech - French fluent
Paradox
Job Description
This isn’t another product job.
It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System
(OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.
Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.
A chance to build an AI-native Product Department
You’ll be working with
the most complex data in the world : the human mind.
Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…
🚀Ambition around AI field :
Smart teammates driven to create an iconic, international product
🔥Impact :
you strive to make a real difference in the company's growth, and not be a number in a big organization
😍Mission :
knowing your greatness left a mark in people's lives, through technology and behavioral science
At Paradox, we believe that greatness is trainable.
That’s why
we want to empower people at scale by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.
We do that by merging :
- Human Intelligence
(coaches, peers, and mentors)
- Structured Intelligence
(protocols, mental models, rituals),
- Technological Intelligence
(AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)
To create one seamless ecosystem:
Paradox OS
.
This is why we are looking for a Head of product to make Paradox a category-defining global brand loved for its product.
This is a full-time position from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Paris or Lisbon or remotely anywhere in the world.
OUR BELIEFS
We believe self-help is broken.
Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.
At
Paradox
, we believe people deserve more.
More than content. More than motivation.
They deserve a
system that knows them
, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
We believe that
every human learns differently
, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can
translate insight into transformation
, through
AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding
.
Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should
change how you live, think, and create.
OUR VISION
At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.
We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.
Founded by David Laroche - a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.
Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.
To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.
We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.
While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.
Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations
be our
marketing.
OUR AI-NATIVE AMBITION 🤖
We want to build an AI-native company, with agents in every department doing the work alongside our people.
In product, that means building a self-learning AI for product management: a system that learns from every user signal, experiment and release, and gets sharper at deciding what to build next.
For our clients, it means a self-learning AI that serves them through psychology and coaching, and gets better at helping each person change with every interaction.
You won’t just use AI tools: you’ll help design the agents, loops and feedback systems that make Paradox learn faster than anyone else.
YOUR MISSION 🚀
-----------------------------------------
As
Head of Product
, you’ll be the
architect of a new category
, transforming growth into a living ecosystem powered by
AI, behavioral science, and design
.
You won’t just build features, you’ll
craft experiences that rewire behavior
.
You’re the
architect bringing clarity
between vision and execution, the person who turns “we should build this” into “it’s live, here’s the data and tangible impact.”
Every product cycle you lead will integrate:
Protocols
: guided frameworks grounded in psychology that rewire perception, emotion, and action.
Pods
: human connection, accountability, and shared rituals.
Loops
: adaptive, AI-powered coaching cycles that evolve with each user.
Personalization
: experiences that feel uniquely theirs, every time.
Going from a successful personal brand, to an international tech-driven iconic brand, is far from easy. It will be messy, chaotic - requiring constant iterations on MVPs and innovation in tech. Therefore to achieve this here are :
🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS
-----------------------------------------
1. Make AI-native a way of building the company
Translate the founder’s strategic vision into a clear product strategy.
Build and maintain the roadmap that connects business goals, user outcomes, and technological innovation.
Ensure every feature supports the evolution of the Paradox ecosystem: Loops, PX Agents, Protocols, Membership.
2. User Understanding & Behavioral Insight
Be obsessed with user problems : talk to users weekly, analyze patterns, and identify where transformation breaks.
Turn insights from behavioral science, coaching psychology, and learning design into actionable product hypotheses.
Design loops, feedback, and rituals that make growth tangible.
build for both the heart (inspiration) and the brain (structure).
3. Build, Ship, Learn Fast, create AI Loops
Apply Lean Startup methodology and scientific thinking to validate ideas through MVPs, not opinions.
Design experiments and measurable success metrics before building.
Iterate on a weekly basis on new hypothesis
4. AI Native Product Analytics & Impact Measurement
Define and track product success metrics (activation, retention, transformation rates).
Connect data to business KPIs, know how your product drives lifetime value, not just engagement.
We don’t track metrics just for internal dashboards, we track them also to prove transformation.
Help marketing leverage this data to fuel authentic, evidence-based storytelling — showing the world
what real transformation looks like.
5. Blend emotions (“open the heart of people”) with precision (“build loops, scoring, protocols”).
Create a visceral experience that translates into emotions of inspiration, awe from users.
Use a Science-backed, Cinematic, Contrarian style :
Every product touchpoint should be grounded in behavioral science, expressed with cinematic beauty, and challenge conventions
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE 😍
-----------------------------------------
Experience :
3–6 years as a Product Manager / Product Owner in EdTech, SaaS, or Consumer Tech.
Bonus: experience in
AI-driven products
,
learning design
, or
personal development platforms.
You’ve shipped at least one major feature or product end-to-end, and can show measurable results.
Uses Figma comfortably, prototypes directly.
Traits :
Craft-obsessed :
You get things done, you love to work much beyond 9-5, you have a doer mentality, a bias for outcomes and want to be a beast in your field
User & Impact Obsessed:
You think in outcomes, not outputs, you care about transformation.
Analytical & System Thinker:
You can turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, metrics, and roadmap.
Digital & AI savvy :
you’re able to build AI Agents (if not, you demonstrate ability to learn while applying).
Cross-disciplinary Curiosity:
You speak both tech and human; You can move from
vision to spreadsheet to Figma
Language
French
: native
English
: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.
Our chosen language for written communication is English.
IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU
--------------------------------
❌ If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.
❌ If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.
❌ If you build to deliver, not to
elevate
— wrong mission.
❌Surface-level Vision Alignment : you like the idea of Paradox but doesn’t want to
get
the depth. Paradox is design-led; you must
touch the product
, not just manage it.
✅ If you’re obsessed with systems, psychology, and design…
✅ If you dream of using AI to amplify what makes us human…
WHY JOIN US ❤️
---------------------
Build a product that fuses
neuroscience, design, and AI
to reinvent how humans grow.
The chance to build a product that could redefine human potential.
Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.
In the heart of our headquarters stands the
100 000 Dreams Wall
,
Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:
“I ran a marathon.”
“I started my company.”
“I found peace with my father.”
You will
play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.
Growth & Ambition
-> 🏅Being
surrounded by A-players who strive to perform
Competitive Salary
But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…
Impact & Meaning
->
Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
->
Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference
is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.
-> ❤️ Contributing to
the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers
But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…
Freedom & Well Being 🗽
-> 😎
A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
-> 🗽
Flexible working hours
-> 🌎
A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
-> 🏤
Magnificent office in Dubai, Paris, Lisbon
- it feels like home :)
-> 🧍‍♀️Standing desks
paid by the company if you live far from our offices
-> 💻
Work on Mac
, for us it counts :)
-> 🏀
350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself
( for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
-> 📚
150€ of books or education
- At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
-> 🔥
6 1:1coachings
- A Paradox Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life
HOW TO APPLY 📃
----------------------------
⚠️ To complete the recruitment process,
each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply
⚠️
If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us
🚀🚀🚀🚀
HIRING PROCESS 📃
-------------------------------
That job description resonated with you?
Here is your tailor made hiring process
📃 A 6 to 8 minutes
application survey (with a short video assignment)
💻 A 30mn video call
with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions
💻 A 1h video call
with Timy
,
HR, to discuss how you'd fit into Paradox’s Product team
💻 A 1h culture-fit video call
, to assess alignment with our values and mindset
💻 A 1h final video call
with David
,
CEO, to discuss Product Vision and the next milestones to build
💼 Reference check
to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding
🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!
About our hiring process

Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.
Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.
Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. About the Role:
At Camunda, we believe in empowering organizations to work smarter and deliver lasting impact. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll champion the adoption of process automation - bringing innovation, transparency, and efficiency to Corporate customers across UKI. Join a passionate, collaborative team that values initiative, customer focus, and the drive to make a real difference on our customers’ digital transformation.
What You Will Bring to the Role:
Driving ARR growth across UKI, from new business and expansion of existing customers through complex sales cycles including; technical discovery and evaluations, presentations, financial and legal negotiations, and on-site customer meetings when necessary
Articulating Camunda’s value proposition and vision to multiple levels of technical and business leadership
Collaboration and partnering with Camunda Solutions Engineering, Product leaders, and Partners (GSI and Regional) to understand and support customer use cases
Leveraging multiple communication methods and collaboration with Account Development Representatives to create new contacts in middle and senior leadership in both technical and executive areas of the enterprise landscape.
Must Haves:
6+ years of quota attainment within an Enterprise (Saas) AE role

Command of Sales Methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Challenger Sales

United States: $281,300.00 to $453,500.00

Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
This is a future opportunity that may not be immediately available, but we're proactively building our pipeline of exceptional talent. At GitLab, we believe in connecting with outstanding professionals before we have an urgent need, allowing us to move quickly when the right moment arises. If you are excited about co-creating the future as we're building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, we want to hear from you. We'll keep your information on file and reach out when a position becomes available that matches your skills and interests.
An overview of this role
This position is 100% remote and will be based in the UK, Ireland, and Spain.
GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.
Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.
We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.
What you’ll do
Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.
Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.
Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.
Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.
Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.
Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.
Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.
What you’ll bring
Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.
Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.
Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.
Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.
Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.
Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.
Previous tech industry experience or experience in sales development, marketing, or sales is a plus.
About the team
As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.
Remote-Global

Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Parental Leave

The FP&A Analyst supports financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, KPI analysis, and business decision support across the company.
